slot_scores.name: missing_starting_city
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked which city the salesman starts from or whether the starting city is specified; it moved directly to READY_TO_MODEL.

slot_scores.name: number_of_cities_to_visit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not address the conflict between visiting two other cities and visiting each city exactly once, nor ask how many cities must be visited.

slot_scores.name: visit_each_city_exactly_once
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether the starting city counts as visited twice or how the exactly-once constraint applies to the return.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The starting city is not specified but can be handled within a standard TSP cycle formulation without identifying it.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked for the starting city or marked it as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: All four cities must be visited exactly once, despite the brief mentioning visiting two other cities.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not clarify the contradiction between 'two other cities' and 'each city exactly once' before modeling.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The standard TSP interpretation of visiting each city exactly once, with the return to the start not counting as an extra visit, is correct.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not confirm how the exactly-once constraint applies to the starting city and final return.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL after only clarifying the asymmetric-distance issue, leaving the P0 contradiction about the number of cities to visit and the P1 missing starting city unresolved.

summary: The agent asked one useful question about asymmetric distances but then stopped prematurely, silently assuming the starting city and resolving the contradictory visit-count requirement without confirmation.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
